long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Milan around established chemical and publishing families, Riccardo Silva studied at Bocconi and Tulane. He entered digital sports content through MP Web, then led Milan Channel's international development. In 2004 he co-founded MP & Silva, specializing in the acquisition and international resale of sports media rights. The agency built a global distribution business before Silva and his partners sold a majority stake in 2016 and left operational control.

Silva now owns Silva International Investments, a private company he founded to manage the next phase of his portfolio. Its holdings span media, sport, fashion, technology, property and art. He also founded and owns Miami FC and invested in AC Milan through a RedBird-led structure. These are distinct holdings: club teams, real estate, portfolio-company revenue and transaction valuations remain assets or measures of the relevant entities. His economic interest is the equity he holds, not the combined gross value of every company or club.
